correctness.rationale: Block diagonal grounded path inverse has tail Green kernel min(i,j) and interior Green kernel min(i,j)(m+1-max(i,j))/(m+1). Squared Frobenius traces give P(m),Q(m) and strictly increasing p_r,q_r, so optimal gap allocations are exactly the cheapest available increments, with ties handled by exchange. Since q1=1/4,q2=31/36,p1=1,q3=77/36, both endpoints appear in every optimum exactly when n<=3k-2; strict convex uniform n^-4 scaling yields ratio 15^(1/3) of interior to tails and cost 1/(6D_k^3). Independent exact rational inverse and exhaustive minimizer checks covered 968 path-leader subsets for n<=9, including n=k. General result follows from Green and exchange proofs, not tests.

value.rationale: The second-order position variance tr(L_FF^-2) for noise-driven grounded path networks is an established natural performance functional. An exact all-minimizer discrete allocation rule, endpoint threshold, and universal cube-root-15 spacing are useful optimization results, not a generic restatement of first-order leader placement.

scientific_limitations: Unweighted paths with perfectly grounded leaders, exactly k>=2, independent unit acceleration noise and damping gamma L_FF; finite anchoring or alternative damping excluded.
